clips.title: The story
paras: In Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix prepares a crate for a Snufflenose Gopher.

Mebok Mizzyrix sends trained Snufflenose Gophers to find Blueleaf Tubers in Razorfen Kraul. The gophers cannot follow an adventurer across the Barrens on foot, so Mebok places each one in a wooden crate with air holes. Inside the quilboar stronghold, the crate is opened and the gopher follows its keen nose toward the buried tubers.
